'''Hylo Sortuli''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] from [[Mirial/Legends|Mirial]] who owned the pet [[Lizard/Legends|lizard]] [[Bonebark]]. She was named after [[Hylo Visz]], a millennia-old legend of the Mirialan people. Hylo Sortuli served under [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] on [[Contruum/Legends|Contruum]] and then took over as [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the ''[[Shadow Raptor]]'' when they joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. Shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] suffered a [[Shadow Raptor revolt|revolt]] from sabotaged [[Droid/Legends|droids]], and she was captured by the [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series tactical droid]] [[TJ-11]].

==Behind the scenes==
Hylo Sortuli appears in [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[2014]] [[roleplaying game]] adventure ''[[Dead in the Water]]''. According to how the players perform, Sortuli may be rescued or killed.
